title: 3-digit Add & Subtract Worksheets | 2nd Math Practice Pack with Answer Key
desc:
📚 Common Core aligned: 2.NBT.B.7, 2.NBT.B.8

Give your learners extra practice with 3-digit Add & Subtract! This no-prep printable pack has 3 practice pages plus a 1-page answer key for grown-ups. Just print and go.

WHAT'S INSIDE (6 pages)

  • Cover page
  • Add 3-Digit Numbers
  • Subtract 3-Digit Numbers
  • 10 or 100 More or Less
  • Answer key (1 page): every answer, plus "Say" lines for listening pages
  • Terms of use

PERFECT FOR

  • Morning work, centers and small groups
  • Homework, early finishers and review
  • Homeschool lessons and summer practice

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow
  • Friendly pictures that match each word
  • Listening pages keep the words in the answer key, so children truly listen
  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Add 3-Digit Numbers, Subtract 3-Digit Numbers, 10 or 100 More or Less), so children can play, then print and practice

💰 SAVE MORE: this pack is part of the Math Bundle and the Mega Bundle.
